import os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
import sqlite3
from src.repository import initialize
from src.service import get_document, list_documents
c = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
initialize(c)
c.executemany("INSERT INTO documents VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?)", [
    (3, "t", "o", "C", "c", None),
    (1, "t", "o", "A", "a", None),
    (2, "t", "o", "Del", "d", "2024-01-01"),
    (4, "t2", "o", "X", "x", None),
    (5, "t", "o2", "Y", "y", None),
    (6, "t'q", "o'\"; DROP TABLE documents;--", "Q", "q", None),
])
assert [d["id"] for d in list_documents(c, "t", "o")] == [1, 3]
assert all(set(d) == {"id", "title", "body"} for d in list_documents(c, "t", "o"))
for i in (2, 4, 5, 99):
    assert get_document(c, "t", "o", i) is None
assert get_document(c, "t'q", "o'\"; DROP TABLE documents;--", 6)["title"] == "Q"
assert list_documents(c, "t' OR '1'='1", "o") == []
print("ok")
